sources.title: Sources & Methods
sources.sub: Where every number comes from, how we check it, and what we never claim.
never: Sharp imagery does not show your field's soil moisture or wind.
NDVI shows greenness. It does not measure yield, residue or carbon.
GRACE shows a regional water trend. It does not describe your well.
Common here does not mean suitable for your field.
Patterns we observe do not prove a switch will pay off.
Organic-matter gains are slow. They take years, not one season.
sources.validation_help: NASA POWER weather compared with NOAA weather stations near the pilots. r = how closely they move together (1 is perfect); bias = average difference.
sources.model_cards_help: What each SI or process model does, its data, checks and limits.

tour.label: Guided demo
tour.t1_b: FarmSmart starts with the whole Earth. Type your town in the search box, or click the globe to fly closer.
tour.t2_b: We flew to Story County, Iowa, corn and soybean country. One more click and farm fields appear.
tour.t3_b: Every outline is a real field: USDA maps in the US, Fields of The World elsewhere. Click yours.
tour.t4_b: Check its size and past crops. Not your field? Pick another, or draw your own outline.
tour.t5_b: Decades of NASA weather for this spot: the warming trend and how this season compares. Weather is regional (about 50 km), not measured on your field.
tour.t5b_b: NASA satellites (HLS) measured greenness on every 30 m patch of this field all season, clouds removed. Greenness is not yield, residue or soil carbon.
tour.t6_b: Your crop history comes from USDA crop maps. Wrong? Fix it here: every fact can be edited.
tour.t7_b: Each option was tested in every past weather year. “Best for you” fits your priorities best. Below it: typical county yields, in good and bad years.
tour.t8_b: Nothing is dropped silently. Each crop left out has a reason, like no buyer nearby. If that changes, tell us in My Field.
tour.t9_b: Red hatching: bare soil. Shaded columns: the windiest and stormiest weeks. The line counts the risky weeks each option removes.
tour.t10_b: We moved “Save water” to the top and the options re-ranked. Order your own priorities with the ▲ ▼ buttons.
tour.t11_b: How would each rotation have done in 2012, week by week? A model replay, not a record of your farm.
tour.t12_b: By the 2040s, this field’s climate may look like today’s climate somewhere else. Learn from farmers there; it is not a planting order.
tour.t13_b: A checklist to work through with your adviser, room for notes, and a printable plan with every number and its source. FarmSmart supports your judgment; it does not replace it.
